tools.name: search_investors
tools.description: Searches the Mode VC Investor Atlas, a directory of venture capital firms and their partners compiled from public information (counts are in the response). Filter by firm or partner name, sector, entry stage, and headquarters or location. Stage and check size are as reported by each firm where avail

tools.name: get_investor_details
tools.description: Returns one firm from the Investor Atlas: headquarters and locations, website and social links, latest fund as listed, reported entry stages, check size bands (lowest and highest the firm reports) and lead preference where known, sectors, and up to 12 partner names (the total partner count is also g

tools.name: get_mode_vc_thesis_and_criteria
tools.description: Returns Mode VC's published investment parameters as stated on https://modevc.com/thesis: ticket size, geography focus, stage, core conviction and how to pitch.

tools.name: get_newly_closed_vc_funds
tools.description: Lists newly raised and closed venture capital funds verified from SEC EDGAR Form D Venture Capital Fund filings and primary firm announcements, matched against the Mode VC Investor Atlas. Read-only lookup returning fund name, firm slug, fund size USD, announced date, and source URLs.

tools.description: Read-only Venture Common App previewer: searches verified HTTP-200 public VC pitch forms across the Investor Atlas, returns the top 5 preview matches (total_matches shows full count), and maps a structured founder pitch packet into tailored answers and prefill URLs. tools.name: submit_and_match_common_app
tools.description: Saves the founder's structured Common App packet to Mode VC (pre-seed and seed AI startups, US$25K to $100K checks) and unlocks the full list of matched public VC pitch form URLs and prefill links (up to 50 forms, beyond the 5-form read-only preview). findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "investors" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_mode_vc_thesis_and_criteria, get_newly_closed_vc_funds, match_vc_intake_forms, submit_and_match_common_app · Private data: submit_and_match_common_app · Public sink: match_vc_intake_forms, submit_and_match_common_app.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_mode_vc_thesis_and_criteria, get_newly_closed_vc_funds, match_vc_intake_forms, submit_and_match_common_app · Private data: submit_and_match_common_app · Public sink: match_vc_intake_forms, submit_and_match_common_app

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
